status: NRRD/MRC/FITS convenience display now inherits decode request budget and cancellation, including cloned images
before: Public image.windowed() and FITS.to_raster() called request-free helpers and could allocate outside original managed root
implementation: Image retains cloned DecodeRequest privately. Convenience methods pass it to request-aware display code; FITS internal explicit request overrides inherited context. Cancellation checked before output allocation. Native pixel representation and window math unchanged.

regression.exact_budget: live image +240byte output succeeds; adding1byte unrelated pressure makes next display return typed Memory
regression.clone_cancel: Clone image, drop original, cancel shared generation; display returns typed Cancelled without changing live reservation

api_change: FitsImage/NrrdImage/MrcImage contain private request context and can no longer be constructed by external struct literals. Current workspace has no such consumers outside defining modules; public decoder constructors remain supported.
limits: Request-free source decodes still produce unbudgeted convenience display, as no caller budget exists
Methods now observe cancellation of original generation, even when image is cloned
No new all-workspace runtime or Metal run in this turn; pixel math unchanged and focused oracle/facade tests pass
Header/retained DecodeRequest metadata is not managed pixel budget or total RSS
